name: User cites framework but never applies it; AI accepts vague answers

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: How would you think about expanding into a new market?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I would start by doing a Porter's Five Forces analysis to understand the competitive landscape. SWOT can also help frame strengths and weaknesses. Generally speaking these frameworks tell us what's going on in any market.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: It depends on the market really, kind of like a case-by-case basis.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Sounds good. Next question — how would you prioritize?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'd use the Eisenhower matrix or similar prioritization framework. Maybe RICE scoring. In theory these help.
